label: route_contract.py TOOL_MAP binds imagician/video-audio and TOOL_VALUES closes the enum over them, while SKILL.md TOOL_MAP binds the literal ffmpeg for every mode; the two copies of one contract emit different tool values and neither names a real Media Editor tool

The router is written three times (SKILL.md fence L129-244, kernel fence, route_contract.py) with no differential.py in benchmark/router, so the skill-fence-to-contract pair is unchecked; the required extraction is five ordered steps following the Product Owner precedent and lands as the kernel's final section 7 ROUTER CODE

RESOURCE_MAP appears in SKILL.md L145-151, the kernel fence and route_contract.py L106-113; guarded loading makes a stale path load nothing silently, rule_parity.py reads none of it, and only fixtures.json plus run_fixtures.sh would fail loudly, so the rename must be atomic across four files

The tool-first command mapping exists only in the SKILL.md L297 prose sentence; five tables (SKILL.md L44-46 command triggers, SKILL.md L288-295 operating modes with a Local tool column, AGENTS.md L107-116 command registry, README L104-111 and L117-124) all carry the fallback only

There is no README section 4 tool table (section 4 is format and quality intelligence); the tool-bearing surfaces are sections 2, 3, 7 and 12, and section 8's seven-knowledge-file count breaks when the tools catalogue is added

Desktop setup facts live only in INSTALL-GUIDE.md and are correct there (allow media files, output folder media files/export, no empty Directory path row); the three surfaces under review state no setting and should keep only their pointers, with manifest user_config keys allowed_directories and output_directory unaffected by the name change

Escalate if is the fleet's only lowercase escalation heading (SKILL.md 337, kernel 289) and the plugin ships an identical copy at mcp server/claude-plugin/skills/media-editor/SKILL.md 337, so the case pass is three files with a rebuild

Three self-descriptions still frame the system as ffmpeg-driven (SKILL.md L366 speaks of a router that drives ffmpeg, L414 gives ffmpeg every operation, L425 and README section 8 use additive or rather than ordered preference), so a filename-only sweep leaves the cover text describing a fallback-first system

Audio trim stays an ffmpeg-fallback operation because video/trim.ts calls requireVideoStream and audio/extract.ts has no time fields, closing the carried Q1 residual and implying the tools catalogue cannot be a one-line-per-mode capability claim
